scientific_question: Does calibration-only selective promotion of the source-symmetric sequential EOG contextual representation improve untouched real ecological prediction relative to the frozen conventional baseline?

dataset.title: Snapshot Japan 2023: the first camera trap dataset under a globally standardised protocol in Japan

independent_public_inclusion_evidence.source: published Table 1 in the data paper

independently_published_response_schema.binary_response_rule: for each active deployment-day, y=1 iff at least one target sequence has start_time on that local calendar day; otherwise y=0
independently_published_response_schema.missing_value_rule: missing or malformed deployment_id/start_time rows are ineligible; no imputation; blank/non-target sequences do not create positives

qualification_order: Stage0 may access deployments payload only and must verify immutable identity, >=50 unique coordinates, active-date coverage, and materializable temporal blocks.
Only after Stage0 qualification may a final contract freeze exact temporal partition, baseline, worlds, Layer B, learner, selector, estimability minima, and once-only response route.
Only then may the response file be opened once.

candidate_partition_rule_before_stage0.rule: After Stage0 reveals deployment-only active-day support, choose the earliest chronological cutpoints that allocate approximately 60% / 20% / 20% of eligible active deployment-days to inner-train / inner-validation / outer-heldout, subject to each partition retaining at least 50 unique deployments; cutpoints are then frozen before response access.

prediction_design_fixed_now.selector: promote contextual arm iff inner-validation macro log loss is strictly lower than baseline; otherwise baseline-only
prediction_design_fixed_now.layer_b: source-symmetric sequential contextual innovation representation using only target positives strictly before the scored day

stop_rules.transport_or_identity_failure: terminal pre-response STOP; no route repair within this attempt
stop_rules.nonresponse_structure_failure: terminal pre-response STOP; no split/threshold rescue within this attempt
stop_rules.response_schema_failure_after_open: terminal consumed STOP; no parser repair
stop_rules.estimability_failure_after_open: terminal consumed STOP; no focal-taxon substitution
stop_rules.scored_result: favorable, tie, or adverse are all terminal
